projects.name: Workflow Tool & Candidate Web Application V3
projects.description: A platform for managing candidate workflows, interviews, and availability, enabling candidates to take tests and live interviews
myContribution: Lead Architecture design and development from design to production
Collaborate with the backend team for the integration of the features
Collaborate with product team, CS team and other stakeholders for the roadmap planning and feature development
projects.technologyUsageDescription: Designed architecture using Nx Monorepo with React, TypeScript and TailwindCSS, bundled with Webpack for code-splitting, caching strategies, and performance optimization. Built collaborative content management features using Blocknote and EditorJs editors for rich text editing. Integrated Hasura GraphQL with Apollo Client, managed state with Redux and Redux-Saga, and implemented Hasura Subscriptions via WebSocket for real-time updates. Integrated tavus.io for AI-powered video interviews. Implemented performance improvements through code-splitting, lazy loading, and bundling optimizations. Wrote unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library. Deployed applications with Docker and automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions. Implemented error tracking with Sentry

projects.name: Teserra Components Library
projects.description: A library of components for the Teserra platform
projects.technologyUsageDescription: Designed architecture for reusable component library with React and TypeScript using monorepo. Styled components with TailwindCSS and built accessible components using Shadcn/ui on Radix UI primitives. Integrated Blocknote and ProseMinor editors as reusable editor components for rich text editing. Implemented accessibility standards with ARIA attributes and keyboard navigation for all component elements. Documented components in Storybook and automated visual regression testing with Chromatic. Wrote unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library, and end-to-end tests with Cypress

projects.name: Candidate Web Application V2
projects.description: A platform where candidates can take the test and live interview and manage their availability
myContribution: Architecture design and development from design to production
Migrate legacy code to new architecture
Collaborate with the backend team for the integration of the features
Collaborate with product team for the roadmap planning and feature development
projects.technologyUsageDescription: Designed micro-frontend architecture with React and TypeScript, migrated legacy code from Ember.js and styled with Material UI. Implemented Webpack Module Federation for runtime module sharing. Optimized performance through bundling improvements, caching strategies, and code-splitting. Integrated RESTful API endpoints and managed state with Redux. Deployed with Docker and automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions

projects.name: Recruit Web Application & Candidate Web Application
projects.description: A platform for orchestrating and managing data flow between systems, enabling recruiters to manage candidates and allowing candidates to take tests, live interviews and manage their availability
myContribution: Refactored legacy code in structured way
Provide support to the CS team for the application
Collaborate with the backend team for the integration of the features
Collaborate with product team for the feature development
projects.technologyUsageDescription: Built single-page applications with Ember.js for recruiter workflows and candidate interfaces. Implemented business logic with JavaScript and integrated RESTful API for candidate management, scheduling, and test-taking. Integrated EditorJs for rich text editing capabilities. Optimized performance using Ember Data, implemented Ember Table for data tables and Ember Calendar for scheduling. Refactored legacy code and styled with Semantic UI

projects.name: Proview Live Proctor
projects.description: A platform for invigilators to monitor the candidates during the test and live interview
myContribution: Architecture design and development from design to production
Collaborate with the backend team for the integration of the features
Collaborate with product team for the feature development
projects.technologyUsageDescription: Designed architecture for real-time proctoring dashboard with React and JavaScript. Integrated RESTful API for monitoring and activity tracking, implemented sortable tables with react-table and styled with Semantic UI. Integrated Video.js for HLS live streaming, video playback, and streaming enhancements with custom plugins and optimizations. Implemented real-time chat with Getstream.io via WebSocket. Bundled application with Webpack for performance optimization and code-splitting
